events.title: The Senate recognises Vespasian as emperor
events.description: The day after Vitellius was killed in Rome, the Senate granted Vespasian the powers of emperor, ending the Year of the Four Emperors. His Flavian dynasty restored stability and began the Colosseum.
events.html: The day after Vitellius was killed in Rome, the Senate granted Vespasian the powers of emperor, ending the Year of the Four Emperors. His Flavian dynasty restored stability and began the Colosseum.

events.title: Weinsberg surrenders to Conrad III after a siege
events.description: After a siege of several weeks, the town and castle of Weinsberg surrendered to King Conrad III, the first ruler of the Hohenstaufen dynasty. The siege was a decisive clash in the rivalry between the Hohenstaufen and the Welfs.
events.html: After a siege of several weeks, the town and castle of Weinsberg surrendered to King Conrad III, the first ruler of the Hohenstaufen dynasty. The siege was a decisive clash in the rivalry between the Hohenstaufen and the Welfs.

events.title: Batu Khan's Mongols sack Ryazan
events.description: After a short siege, the Mongol army of Batu Khan destroyed Ryazan, the first city of Kievan Rus' to be besieged in the invasion. The city never recovered, and the seat of the principality moved to Pereslavl-Ryazansky.

events.title: Castile defeats the forces of Granada at Linuesa
events.description: At Huesa in the Kingdom of Jaén, the forces of the Kingdom of Castile defeated those of the Emirate of Granada, the last independent Muslim state in Western Europe, in an action of the Reconquista.
events.html: At Huesa in the Kingdom of Jaén, the forces of the Kingdom of Castile defeated those of the Emirate of Granada, the last independent Muslim state in Western Europe, in an action of the Reconquista.

events.title: A Mayflower party lands at Plymouth
events.description: An exploring party from the Mayflower landed at Plymouth harbour, where the Pilgrims decided to settle (11 December Old Style). Half the colonists died during the first winter.
events.html: An exploring party from the Mayflower landed at Plymouth harbour, where the Pilgrims decided to settle (11 December Old Style). Half the colonists died during the first winter.

events.title: The Curies identify radium
events.description: Working in a Paris shed, Marie and Pierre Curie detected a new, intensely radioactive element in pitchblende, announced days later as radium. Isolating it took Marie Curie another twelve years.
events.html: Working in a Paris shed, Marie and Pierre Curie detected a new, intensely radioactive element in pitchblende, announced days later as radium. Isolating it took Marie Curie another twelve years.

events.title: Apollo 8 launches for the Moon
events.description: Frank Borman, Jim Lovell and Bill Anders lifted off on the first crewed flight to leave Earth's orbit. On Christmas Eve they orbited the Moon and photographed 'Earthrise'.
events.html: Frank Borman, Jim Lovell and Bill Anders lifted off on the first crewed flight to leave Earth's orbit. On Christmas Eve they orbited the Moon and photographed 'Earthrise'.

events.title: A bomb destroys Pan Am Flight 103 over Lockerbie
events.description: A bomb exploded aboard a Boeing 747 over Lockerbie in Scotland, killing all 259 on board and 11 people on the ground. A Libyan intelligence officer was convicted in 2001.
